amount_text: Not disclosed; "multi-gigawatt scale" of Vera Rubin systems
title_en: Oracle expands Nvidia deal to multi-gigawatt Vera Rubin superclusters
title_zh: 甲骨文将英伟达合作扩大至数吉瓦级 Vera Rubin 超级集群
summary_en: Oracle and Nvidia said Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's AI superclusters will grow to multi-gigawatt scale on Nvidia's Vera Rubin servers, some using Oracle's own Acceleron networking; the value was not disclosed. Oracle also said it will offer Google TPUs and Cerebras and SambaNova inference chips from 2027.
summary_zh: 甲骨文与英伟达宣布，甲骨文云基础设施的 AI 超级集群将基于英伟达 Vera Rubin 服务器扩展至数吉瓦规模，部分系统采用甲骨文自研的 Acceleron 网络芯片，金额未披露。甲骨文还表示将从 2027 年起提供谷歌 TPU 以及 Cerebras、SambaNova 的推理芯片。

amount_text: "Valued at $2.0+ billion" per Verizon's Q3 2026 release; term not disclosed
title_en: AWS signs $2B+ AI infrastructure deal with Verizon
title_zh: AWS 与威瑞森签署逾 20 亿美元 AI 基础设施协议
summary_en: Verizon said with its Q3 2026 results that it signed an agreement with AWS valued at more than $2B, a commercial framework to scale distributed compute for AI workloads, expanding the November 2025 deal under which Verizon builds long-haul fibre between AWS data centres.
summary_zh: 威瑞森在 2026 年第三季度财报中表示，已与 AWS 签署价值逾 20 亿美元的协议，为 AI 工作负载扩展分布式算力建立商业框架，是对 2025 年 11 月双方协议（威瑞森为 AWS 数据中心之间铺设长途光纤）的扩大。

amount_text: $1.3B for packaging capacity in South Korea (Amkor's announcement as reported; NVIDIA's release confirms the Korea expansion but gives no amount); Amkor puts its multi-year NVIDIA agreements at $3B in all, after the $1.5B Arizona deal of Jul 2026
title_en: NVIDIA prepays Amkor $1.3B for advanced-packaging capacity in Korea
title_zh: 英伟达向安靠预付 13 亿美元锁定韩国先进封装产能
summary_en: Amkor signed a new $1.3 billion agreement with NVIDIA, paid as prepayments, to add advanced-packaging capacity in South Korea, part of the supply-chain expansion NVIDIA announced at GTC on 21 October 2026.
summary_zh: 安靠与英伟达签订新的 13 亿美元协议，以预付款形式锁定韩国先进封装新增产能，属英伟达 2026 年 10 月 21 日在 GTC 上宣布的供应链扩产计划。

amount_text: $1.1B capacity-reservation advance per NVIDIA; KYEC's own disclosure allows up to NT$45B (~$1.4B) of prepayments for its US testing plant (subsidiary AeternZ), agreement signed 2026-10-13
title_en: NVIDIA advances KYEC $1.1B to reserve chip-testing capacity
title_zh: 英伟达向京元电子预付 11 亿美元锁定芯片测试产能
summary_en: NVIDIA gave King Yuan Electronics (KYEC) a $1.1 billion capacity-reservation advance to support new US testing facilities and equipment, with high-volume production targeted for April 2027.
summary_zh: 英伟达向京元电子（KYEC）提供 11 亿美元产能预留预付款，支持其在美国新建测试厂及设备，目标 2027 年 4 月量产。

amount_text: PPA value not disclosed; AEP plans to invest about $4B in the 702 MW Cheyenne Fuel Cell project (Bloom fuel cells, ~$2.65B purchase disclosed by AEP in Jan 2026)
term: 20 years; full operation expected by end of 2028
title_en: Google 20-year power purchase agreement with AEP's Cheyenne fuel-cell plant
title_zh: 谷歌与 AEP 夏延燃料电池电厂的 20 年购电协议
summary_en: Google will buy the output of Cheyenne Fuel Cell, a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell plant near Cheyenne, Wyoming, under a 20-year power purchase agreement; AEP owns about 92% (funds advised by Basalt the rest) and plans to invest about $4B. The plant serves Google's planned Cheyenne data-centre campus.
summary_zh: 谷歌将根据 20 年购电协议，购买怀俄明州夏延附近 702 兆瓦 Bloom 燃料电池电厂 Cheyenne Fuel Cell 的全部电力；AEP 持股约 92%（其余由 Basalt 管理的基金持有），计划投资约 40 亿美元。该电厂为谷歌规划中的夏延数据中心园区供电。

amount_text: Not disclosed; 3,590 MW in total: 20-year PPA for 890 MW of new uprate capacity (Constellation investing >$4.3B) plus a 15-year deal for 2,700 MW of existing PJM output
term: 20 years (890 MW uprates, first in 2028, all by 2032) and 15 years (2,700 MW)
title_en: Google nuclear power agreements with Constellation (3.6 GW)
title_zh: 谷歌与 Constellation 的核电购电协议（3.6 吉瓦）
summary_en: Google signed a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 MW of new output from uprates at 11 Constellation reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, which Constellation says means more than $4.3B of investment, plus a separate 15-year agreement for 2,700 MW of existing Constellation generation in PJM. The price Google pays was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 谷歌与 Constellation 签署 20 年购电协议，购买其在伊利诺伊、宾夕法尼亚和新泽西 11 台反应堆增容改造带来的 890 兆瓦新增电力（Constellation 称将为此投资逾 43 亿美元），另签 15 年协议购买其在 PJM 电网的 2,700 兆瓦现有电力。谷歌支付的价格未披露。

amount_text: ~$7B over 5 years for ~100,000 AI chips, ~30% paid upfront, per FT (not confirmed by either company)
title_en: Tencent leases 100,000 AI chips from Oracle for ~$7B
title_zh: 腾讯以约 70 亿美元向甲骨文租用 10 万颗 AI 芯片
summary_en: The Financial Times reported that Tencent agreed a five-year, roughly $7B deal to rent about 100,000 advanced AI chips in Oracle data centres in Southeast Asia, with about 30% paid upfront. Neither company confirmed it.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，腾讯与甲骨文达成为期五年、价值约 70 亿美元的协议，在甲骨文东南亚数据中心租用约 10 万颗先进 AI 芯片，约 30% 预付。双方均未确认。

subkind: backup generator supply agreement with warrant
amount_text: $2.4B of initial deliveries in 2027-2028; warrant vesting tied to up to $8B of payments (a ceiling)
term: long-term supply; initial deliveries 2027-2028; warrant exercisable to 2033
title_en: Amazon backup-generator supply agreement with Generac
title_zh: 亚马逊与 Generac 的备用发电机供货协议
summary_en: Amazon signed a long-term supply agreement with Generac for backup generators for its data centres, with initial deliveries of $2.4B expected in 2027 and 2028. Generac issued Amazon a warrant for up to 1.69 million shares at about $200.93, vesting as Amazon's generator payments rise toward $8B.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与 Generac 签署长期供货协议，为其数据中心采购备用发电机，首批交付预计 2027 至 2028 年共 24 亿美元。Generac 向亚马逊发行认股权证，可按约 200.93 美元认购最多 169 万股，随亚马逊发电机付款累计至最高 80 亿美元分批归属。

amount_text: ~$13B over five years (Bloomberg, people familiar); not confirmed by either company
title_en: Jane Street's ~$13B five-year cloud compute contract with Crusoe
title_zh: Jane Street 与 Crusoe 签订约 130 亿美元、为期五年的云算力合同
summary_en: Bloomberg reported that Crusoe signed a deal worth about $13 billion over five years to supply the trading firm Jane Street with GPU cloud capacity, its largest cloud contract; neither company confirmed it.
summary_zh: 彭博社报道，Crusoe 与交易公司 Jane Street 签订为期五年、价值约 130 亿美元的 GPU 云算力合同，为其最大的云合同；双方均未证实。

amount_text: ~$35B, ~350 MW at Hut 8's Nueces County, Texas site (WSJ/Reuters); not confirmed by Anthropic, Lambda or Hut 8
title_en: Anthropic commits ~$41.3B to Lambda cloud compute
title_zh: Anthropic 向 Lambda 承诺约 413 亿美元云算力
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 shows three 2026 agreements with Nvidia-backed Lambda for Nvidia GPU compute worth about $41.3B over terms into 2034. The largest, signed in August (~$34.9B), is the roughly $35B deal for about 350 MW at a Hut 8 site in Texas first reported by the WSJ and Reuters; either side may end it if Lambda does not secure the facility lease in time.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》和路透社报道，Anthropic 与英伟达支持的 Lambda 签署约 350 亿美元协议，使用 Hut 8 位于得州的约 350 兆瓦容量，据报道由英伟达持有该数据中心租约。相关公司未予置评。

amount_text: Up to ~$44.6B over terms into 2033 under the August 2026 Nscale Services Agreements, fees accruing only as capacity is delivered and accepted (Anthropic S-1); reported as $45B over 6 years for ~460 MW at the Monarch campus, West Virginia. A second ~$45B deal was reported in talks (Oct 2026)
term: Into 2033; Vera Rubin capacity from late 2027
title_en: Anthropic $45B compute rental from Nscale
title_zh: Anthropic 向 Nscale 租用 450 亿美元算力
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 says it agreed in August 2026 to spend up to about $44.6B with Nscale subsidiaries for NVIDIA GPU compute over terms into 2033, paying only as capacity is delivered; Nscale must use best efforts to line up financing for the GPUs and data centre in time. Bloomberg had reported the deal as $45B for about 460 MW at Nscale's West Virginia campus, and in October 2026 reported talks on a second deal of roughly the same size.
summary_zh: Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，其于 2026 年 8 月与 Nscale 旗下子公司签约，在延续至 2033 年的期限内斥资最多约 446 亿美元租用英伟达 GPU 算力，仅在算力交付后付费；Nscale 须尽力按期为 GPU 和数据中心筹得融资。彭博此前报道该交易为 450 亿美元、约 460 兆瓦（西弗吉尼亚园区），并于 2026 年 10 月报道双方正洽谈规模相近的第二笔交易。

amount_text: ~$10B over six years (Bloomberg); Volta did not name the customer and Anthropic declined to comment
title_en: Anthropic's ~$10B compute deal with Volta
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Volta 约 100 亿美元的算力合同
summary_en: Volta, an Nvidia-backed AI cloud start-up founded in January 2026 by former Brookfield executives, announced a six-year, ~$10 billion compute partnership with an unnamed AI lab that Bloomberg reported is Anthropic. The capacity runs on Nvidia Vera Rubin systems at Bitdeer's Tydal campus in Norway, which Volta leases (separate edge).
summary_zh: 由前布鲁克菲尔德高管于 2026 年 1 月创立、获英伟达支持的 AI 云初创公司 Volta 宣布与一家未具名 AI 实验室签订为期六年、约 100 亿美元的算力合作，彭博社报道该客户为 Anthropic。算力部署于 Volta 向比特小鹿租用的挪威 Tydal 园区（另列），采用英伟达 Vera Rubin 系统。

amount_text: Not counted: non-binding MOU, not placed orders; Samsung estimates >$200B of collaboration over five years through 2030
title_en: Broadcom and Samsung sign $200B memory and foundry MOU
title_zh: 博通与三星签署 2000 亿美元存储与代工合作备忘录
summary_en: Samsung and Broadcom signed an MOU under which Samsung would supply HBM4 and HBM4E and build Broadcom products on 2nm and smaller processes at Pyeongtaek, valued by Samsung at more than $200B over five years; it is a statement of intent rather than a binding contract. The $200B estimate is not counted as an order total.
summary_zh: 三星与博通签署谅解备忘录，三星将供应 HBM4/HBM4E，并在平泽以 2 纳米及更先进工艺代工博通产品，三星估计五年合作规模超过 2000 亿美元；该备忘录为意向而非具约束力的合同。 2000 亿美元为三星估算，不计入订单金额。

subkind: multi-year HBM supply and co-development partnership (letters of intent)
amount_text: Undisclosed for memory; Nvidia and SK Group put the wider partnership (memory plus AI data centres) at more than $500B over five years, via letters of intent without a breakdown
title_en: Nvidia multi-year HBM supply partnership with SK hynix
title_zh: 英伟达与 SK 海力士的多年期 HBM 供应合作
summary_en: Nvidia and SK Group announced an expanded partnership that secures SK hynix HBM for Vera Rubin and joint development of next-generation memory; the more-than-$500B headline also covers data-centre construction, rests on non-binding letters of intent and is not a firm order.
summary_zh: 英伟达与 SK 集团宣布扩大合作，锁定 SK 海力士为 Vera Rubin 供应 HBM 并共同开发下一代存储；所称逾 5000 亿美元规模还包含数据中心建设，基于非约束性意向书，并非确定订单。

amount_text: $1.5B multi-year agreement, paid as prepayments, for advanced packaging and test capacity in the US (Arizona)
title_en: NVIDIA's $1.5B packaging prepayment to Amkor (Arizona)
title_zh: 英伟达向安靠预付 15 亿美元锁定美国（亚利桑那）封装产能
summary_en: Amkor and NVIDIA signed a $1.5 billion multi-year agreement for advanced packaging and test, funded by NVIDIA prepayments that support Amkor's US expansion in Arizona. A second, $1.3 billion agreement for Korea followed in October (separate edge).
summary_zh: 安靠与英伟达签订 15 亿美元多年期先进封装与测试协议，由英伟达以预付款形式支付，支持安靠在亚利桑那的美国扩产；10 月又签订 13 亿美元的韩国产能协议（另列一条）。

amount_text: No fixed dollar commitment; Anthropic's S-1 expects more than $20B of spending if it procures the full initial tranche (calendar 2027), with an option for roughly as much again; up to 2 GW of MI450-series (MI455X) Helios racks
title_en: Anthropic deal for up to 2 GW of AMD MI450 GPUs
title_zh: Anthropic 采购最多 2 吉瓦 AMD MI450 GPU
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to deploy up to 2 GW of AMD Helios racks with Instinct MI455X GPUs and EPYC Venice CPUs, with the first gigawatt from the first half of 2027. Its S-1 says the agreement sets no fixed dollar amount but it expects to spend more than $20B on the initial tranche, non-cancelable by Anthropic except for AMD's uncured breach.
summary_zh: Anthropic 同意部署最多 2 吉瓦搭载 Instinct MI455X GPU 和 EPYC Venice CPU 的 AMD Helios 机架，首个吉瓦于 2027 年上半年开始部署。其 S-1 称协议未设固定金额，但预计首批采购支出将超过 200 亿美元；除 AMD 未补救的重大违约外，Anthropic 不可撤销该协议。

amount_text: "Multibillion-dollar", exact value undisclosed; no new equity stake
title_en: Microsoft's multibillion-dollar compute deal with Mistral AI
title_zh: 微软与 Mistral AI 签订数十亿美元算力协议
summary_en: Microsoft committed multibillion dollars to Mistral's European GPU capacity (thousands of Nvidia Vera Rubin chips) without a new equity stake; Azure customers gain access to Mistral's French data centres and Mistral models join Microsoft Foundry.
summary_zh: 微软承诺向 Mistral 的欧洲 GPU 算力（数千颗英伟达 Vera Rubin 芯片）投入数十亿美元，不新增股权；Azure 客户可使用 Mistral 的法国数据中心，Mistral 模型同时上架微软 Foundry。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no financial terms published
title_en: Apple extends Broadcom chip deal through 2031
title_zh: 苹果与博通芯片合作延长至 2031 年
summary_en: Broadcom disclosed in a securities filing that it will keep developing and supplying custom chips to Apple through 2031; analysts put Apple at about 20% of Broadcom's revenue.
summary_zh: 博通在证券文件中披露，将继续为苹果开发和供应定制芯片至 2031 年；分析师称苹果约占博通营收两成。

amount_text: Framework raised from $5B to $25B; $20B increment counted here (the original $5B is a separate edge)
title_en: Brookfield expands Bloom Energy partnership to $25B
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德将与 Bloom Energy 的合作扩大至 250 亿美元
summary_en: Brookfield raised its framework to finance Bloom Energy fuel-cell power projects for AI infrastructure fivefold, from $5B to $25B, under its AI Infrastructure Fund.
summary_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德通过其 AI 基础设施基金，将为 Bloom Energy 燃料电池电力项目融资的框架从 50 亿美元扩大五倍至 250 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 20-year PPA for up to ~2.67 GW from Chevron's Project Kilby gas plant (plant cost estimated at ~$7B; final investment decision expected by end-2026)
title_en: Microsoft's 20-year power deal with Chevron for a West Texas AI campus
title_zh: 微软与雪佛龙签订 20 年购电协议，为西得州 AI 园区供电
summary_en: Chevron signed a 20-year power purchase agreement to supply Microsoft's data-centre campus near Pecos, West Texas, from Project Kilby, an off-grid gas plant in Reeves County developed with Engine No. 1 that ramps up to about 2.67 GW, with first power by 2028. Terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙与微软签订为期 20 年的购电协议，由其与 Engine No. 1 在里夫斯县开发的离网燃气电厂 Kilby 项目为微软位于西得州佩科斯附近的数据中心园区供电，装机逐步增至约 2.67 吉瓦，2028 年前首次供电。条款未披露。

amount_text: $920M per month, Oct 2026-Jun 2029 (~$30B if run to term); terminable on 90 days' notice from 2027, so no committed total is counted (same rule as the Anthropic-SpaceX rental)
title_en: Google rents SpaceX/xAI compute ($920M a month)
title_zh: 谷歌租用 SpaceX/xAI 算力（每月 9.2 亿美元）
summary_en: A SpaceX SEC filing, as reported by DatacenterDynamics, shows Google will pay $920M a month for about 110,000 Nvidia GPUs and related hardware from October 2026 to June 2029, roughly $30B; either side can exit on 90 days' notice from 2027. Google called it bridge capacity for Gemini Enterprise.
summary_zh: 据 DatacenterDynamics 报道，SpaceX 向美国证交会提交的文件显示，谷歌将在 2026 年 10 月至 2029 年 6 月每月支付 9.2 亿美元，租用约 11 万颗英伟达 GPU 及相关硬件，合计约 300 亿美元；自 2027 年起任一方可提前 90 天退出。谷歌称这是为 Gemini Enterprise 提供的过渡算力。

amount_text: Monthly service fees of up to $2.6B in aggregate over the term (a ceiling, subject to commencement conditions); ~250 MW guaranteed / ~328 MW installed, three phases of 10 years each
term: three phases, each a 10-year supply term
title_en: Nebius fuel-cell power capacity agreement with Bloom Energy
title_zh: Nebius 与 Bloom Energy 的燃料电池供电容量协议
summary_en: On 14 May 2026 a Nebius subsidiary signed a master fuel-cell capacity agreement under which Bloom Energy installs, operates and maintains on-site fuel cells at Nebius data centres (about 250 MW guaranteed, 328 MW installed) and Nebius pays monthly service fees of up to $2.6B over the term. In July 2026 Industrial Development Funding and Oaktree announced a $1.7B project investment to finance the Bloom fuel cells for Nebius.
summary_zh: 2026 年 5 月 14 日，Nebius 旗下子公司与 Bloom Energy 签署燃料电池容量主协议：Bloom 在 Nebius 数据中心现场安装、运营和维护燃料电池（保证容量约 250 兆瓦，装机约 328 兆瓦），Nebius 在合同期内按月支付服务费，总额最高 26 亿美元。2026 年 7 月，Industrial Development Funding 与橡树资本宣布投入 17 亿美元为这批供 Nebius 使用的 Bloom 燃料电池提供项目融资。

amount_text: ~$1.6B for air-cooled NVIDIA Blackwell systems (GPUs, servers, storage, networking, services), paid within 30 days of each tranche shipping
title_en: IREN buys $1.6B of Blackwell systems from Dell
title_zh: IREN 向戴尔采购 16 亿美元 Blackwell 系统
summary_en: IREN agreed to buy about $1.6B of NVIDIA Blackwell systems from Dell for its Childress, Texas campus to serve its five-year, $3.4B AI cloud contract with NVIDIA; IREN guarantees its subsidiary's payments.
summary_zh: IREN 同意向戴尔采购约 16 亿美元英伟达 Blackwell 系统，部署于得州 Childress 园区，用于履行与英伟达为期五年、34 亿美元的 AI 云合同；IREN 为子公司付款提供担保。

amount_text: Not disclosed; Crux AI buys Google TPUs for ~500 MW of capacity targeted in 2027, financed by Blackstone's $5B equity and a ~$22B bank loan
title_en: Crux AI purchase of Google TPUs
title_zh: Crux AI 采购谷歌 TPU
summary_en: Crux AI, the TPU cloud venture of Blackstone and Google, buys Google's TPUs to rent them out as compute, aiming for 500 MW of capacity in 2027; the chips are financed by Blackstone's initial $5B of equity and a roughly $22B loan from ten banks. The purchase value was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 黑石与谷歌合资的 TPU 云公司 Crux AI 向谷歌采购 TPU 芯片并对外出租算力，目标是 2027 年达到 500 兆瓦容量；采购资金来自黑石首期 50 亿美元股权和十家银行约 220 亿美元贷款。采购金额未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; chips and process node not named
title_en: Apple reaches preliminary deal for Intel to make some of its chips
title_zh: 苹果与英特尔达成初步代工协议
summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Apple and Intel reached a preliminary agreement for Intel's foundry to make some Apple-designed chips after more than a year of talks; neither company has confirmed it.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，经过一年多谈判，苹果与英特尔达成初步协议，由英特尔代工部分苹果自研芯片；两家公司均未确认。

amount_text: ~$3.4B total contract value over 5 years (through 2032), three tranches deployed during 2027
title_en: NVIDIA $3.4B GPU cloud contract with IREN
title_zh: 英伟达与 IREN 签订 34 亿美元 GPU 云合同
summary_en: NVIDIA signed a five-year contract worth about $3.4B for dedicated GPU cloud services from IREN at its Childress, Texas campus, for NVIDIA's own AI and research workloads. The same day NVIDIA bought rights to invest up to $2.1B in IREN (separate edge).
summary_zh: 英伟达与 IREN 签订为期五年、约 34 亿美元的专用 GPU 云服务合同，由 IREN 得州 Childress 园区提供，用于英伟达自身的 AI 与研究工作负载。同日英伟达还购入最多向 IREN 投资 21 亿美元的权利（另列一条）。

amount_text: Up to $120.5B through 2029 under the SpaceXAI arrangements per Anthropic's S-1, ~$3.1B a month once all capacity is delivered (expected Dec 2026); first disclosed at ~$1.25B a month in SpaceX's May S-1. Maximum contract value (as for Google's SpaceX deal): initial non-cancelable periods end Jan and Mar 2027, then either side can exit on 90 days' notice
term: Through 2029 at most; initial periods end Jan/Mar 2027, then terminable on 90 days' notice
title_en: Anthropic rents SpaceX/xAI compute (up to $120.5B)
title_zh: Anthropic 租用 SpaceX/xAI 算力（最高 1205 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to use all compute at SpaceX's (xAI's) Colossus 1 in Memphis, over 300 MW, and later added Colossus 2. Its S-1 shows the deals, signed and amended between May and October 2026, total up to $120.5B through 2029, about $3.1B a month once all capacity is delivered in December 2026. After non-cancelable periods ending in January and March 2027, either side can exit on 90 days' notice.
summary_zh: Anthropic 同意使用 SpaceX（xAI）位于孟菲斯的 Colossus 1 全部算力（逾 300 兆瓦），之后又加入 Colossus 2。其 S-1 显示，这些在 2026 年 5 月至 10 月间签署和修订的协议在 2029 年前合计最高 1205 亿美元，2026 年 12 月全部容量交付后每月约 31 亿美元。不可撤销期分别于 2027 年 1 月和 3 月结束，此后任一方可提前 90 天通知退出。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no contract value given
title_en: Tesla picks Intel 14A for its Terafab chips
title_zh: 特斯拉选择英特尔 14A 工艺生产 Terafab 芯片
summary_en: On Tesla's Q1 2026 earnings call Elon Musk said Tesla plans to make AI chips at its Terafab complex on Intel's 14A process, which would make Tesla the first major named external 14A customer.
summary_zh: 马斯克在特斯拉 2026 年第一季度财报电话会上表示，特斯拉计划在 Terafab 项目中采用英特尔 14A 工艺生产 AI 芯片，使特斯拉成为 14A 首个公开的大客户。

amount_text: At least $110B with AWS through April 2036 regardless of usage, non-cancelable except for Amazon's material breach, per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026); announced in Apr 2026 as >$100B over 10 years, up to 5 GW incl. Trainium2-Trainium4
title_en: Anthropic commits $110B to AWS through 2036 (>$100B announced)
title_zh: Anthropic 承诺至 2036 年在 AWS 支出 1100 亿美元（公告时为逾 1000 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic secured up to 5 GW of AWS capacity, with nearly 1 GW of Trainium2 and Trainium3 online by end-2026, and committed more than $100B to AWS services over ten years. Its October 2026 S-1 puts the minimum at $110B through April 2036, non-cancelable except for a material breach by Amazon.
summary_zh: Anthropic 锁定最多 5 吉瓦 AWS 算力，其中近 1 吉瓦 Trainium2/Trainium3 将于 2026 年底前上线，并承诺十年内在 AWS 服务上支出逾 1000 亿美元。其 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示最低承诺为至 2036 年 4 月 1100 亿美元，除亚马逊重大违约外不可撤销。

amount_text: ~$6B commitment to CoreWeave cloud services across several data centres, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems (term not disclosed)
title_en: Jane Street $6B AI cloud deal with CoreWeave
title_zh: Jane Street 与 CoreWeave 签订 60 亿美元 AI 云合同
summary_en: Trading firm Jane Street committed about $6B to CoreWeave cloud services, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin capacity, and at the same time bought $1B of CoreWeave stock (separate edge).
summary_zh: 交易公司 Jane Street 承诺采购约 60 亿美元 CoreWeave 云服务（含英伟达 Vera Rubin 算力），同时认购 10 亿美元 CoreWeave 股票（另列一条）。

amount_text: Undisclosed; initial commitment of more than 1 GW, the first phase of a multi-gigawatt rollout
title_en: Meta commits to multi-gigawatt MTIA custom chips with Broadcom
title_zh: Meta 与博通签署数吉瓦 MTIA 定制芯片合作
summary_en: Broadcom and Meta extended their custom-silicon partnership through 2029 across several MTIA generations, with Meta committing to an initial deployment of more than 1 GW on 2nm; Hock Tan moves from Meta's board to an advisory role.
summary_zh: 博通与 Meta 将定制芯片合作延长至 2029 年，覆盖多代 MTIA，Meta 承诺首期部署逾 1 吉瓦的 2 纳米芯片；博通 CEO 陈福阳将由 Meta 董事会转任顾问。

amount_text: Undisclosed; up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cells (1.2 GW already contracted for 2026–27); Bloom issued Oracle a warrant for 3,531,073 shares at $113.28 (agreed Oct 2025, issued 2026-04-09, exercised cashless on 2026-05-01 for 1,905,433 shares)
title_en: Oracle fuel-cell supply deal with Bloom Energy (up to 2.8 GW)
title_zh: 甲骨文与 Bloom Energy 的燃料电池供电协议（最高 2.8 吉瓦）
summary_en: Bloom Energy said it will supply Oracle with up to 2.8 GW of fuel-cell capacity for its AI and cloud data centres under an expanded master agreement, of which 1.2 GW is already contracted and being deployed. The value was not disclosed; Bloom also issued Oracle a warrant.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy 表示，根据扩大后的主协议，将为甲骨文的 AI 和云数据中心提供最高 2.8 吉瓦的燃料电池发电容量，其中 1.2 吉瓦已签约并在部署中。金额未披露；Bloom 还向甲骨文发行了认股权证。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: Anthropic multi-year cloud deal with CoreWeave
title_zh: Anthropic 与 CoreWeave 的多年期云合同
summary_en: Anthropic signed a multi-year agreement to run Claude workloads on CoreWeave, a day after CoreWeave's $21B Meta expansion; terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: Anthropic 签署多年期协议在 CoreWeave 上运行 Claude 工作负载，时间在 CoreWeave 与 Meta 210 亿美元扩容协议次日，条款未披露。

amount_text: ~$21B through Dec 2032; total Meta-CoreWeave contracts ~$35B
title_en: Meta expands CoreWeave contract by $21B
title_zh: Meta 追加 210 亿美元 CoreWeave 合同
summary_en: Meta signed a further ~$21B of CoreWeave capacity through 2032, including early Nvidia Vera Rubin deployments for inference, taking its total CoreWeave commitments to about $35B.
summary_zh: Meta 再签约约 210 亿美元 CoreWeave 算力（至 2032 年），包括首批用于推理的英伟达 Vera Rubin 部署，使其对 CoreWeave 的承诺总额达约 350 亿美元。

subkind: long-term custom TPU development and supply agreement
amount_text: Undisclosed; no pricing or minimum volumes disclosed
title_en: Google locks in Broadcom for TPUs through 2031
title_zh: 谷歌与博通签署至 2031 年的 TPU 长期协议
summary_en: Broadcom disclosed in an 8-K a long-term agreement to develop and supply future generations of Google's custom TPUs, plus a supply-assurance deal for networking and other parts of Google's AI racks through 2031, alongside expanded TPU capacity for Anthropic.
summary_zh: 博通在 8-K 中披露与谷歌签订长期协议，开发并供应未来多代定制 TPU，另签供应保障协议覆盖谷歌 AI 机架的网络及其他部件至 2031 年，同时扩大为 Anthropic 提供的 TPU 产能。

amount_text: At least ~$114.5B of Google TPU spend between April 2026 and July 2033 per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026), non-cancelable except for Google's uncured material breach, with a true-up if spending falls short; this covers Anthropic's Google TPU deals together, so the Oct 2025 edge stays without an amount. 5 GW of next-gen TPU capacity from 2027 (Anthropic); a Broadcom filing cited ~3.5 GW
title_en: Anthropic 5 GW TPU deal with Google and Broadcom
title_zh: Anthropic 与谷歌、博通的 5 吉瓦 TPU 协议
summary_en: Anthropic signed with Google and Broadcom for 5 GW of next-generation TPU capacity coming online from 2027, which its CFO called its largest compute commitment to date; an earlier Broadcom filing cited about 3.5 GW. Anthropic's S-1 (October 2026) shows a minimum of about $114.5B of Google TPU commitments from April 2026 through July 2033, with a true-up payment if spending falls short, plus further TPU compute to be delivered in 2028-2031.
summary_zh: Anthropic 与谷歌及博通签约，自 2027 年起获得 5 吉瓦下一代 TPU 算力，其首席财务官称这是公司迄今最大的算力承诺；博通此前的文件显示规模约 3.5 吉瓦。Anthropic 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示，2026 年 4 月至 2033 年 7 月间对谷歌 TPU 的最低承诺约 1145 亿美元，支出不足须补足差额，另有 2028–2031 年交付的更多 TPU 算力。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: Meta is first customer for Arm's own AGI CPU
title_zh: Meta 成为 Arm 自研 AGI CPU 首个客户
summary_en: Arm launched its first in-house chip, the AGI CPU made on TSMC 3nm, with Meta, which co-developed it, as the first customer, moving Arm beyond licensing into selling silicon.
summary_zh: Arm 推出首款自研芯片——采用台积电 3 纳米的 AGI CPU，共同开发者 Meta 为首个客户，标志 Arm 从授权模式转向直接销售芯片。

amount_text: Undisclosed; named as an early customer, no volumes or terms disclosed
title_en: OpenAI named as early customer for Arm's AGI CPU
title_zh: OpenAI 被列为 Arm AGI CPU 的早期客户
summary_en: OpenAI was named among the early customers for Arm's first in-house data-centre chip, the AGI CPU, alongside Cloudflare and SAP; no order size was given.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Cloudflare、SAP 一同被列为 Arm 首款自研数据中心芯片 AGI CPU 的早期客户；未披露订单规模。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no volumes, prices or term disclosed
title_en: AMD and Samsung MOU for primary HBM4 supply
title_zh: AMD 与三星签署 HBM4 主力供应谅解备忘录
summary_en: Samsung and AMD signed an MOU to align on primary HBM4 supply for the Instinct MI455X GPU and DRAM for EPYC Venice, and to discuss Samsung foundry work; Lisa Su revisited Samsung in October 2026 as talks on a firmer long-term deal continued.
summary_zh: 三星与 AMD 签署谅解备忘录，三星将作为 Instinct MI455X GPU 的 HBM4 主力供应商并为 EPYC Venice 提供 DRAM，双方还将探讨代工合作；2026 年 10 月苏姿丰再访三星，长期协议仍在商谈。

amount_text: Up to ~$27B: $12B dedicated capacity + up to $15B purchase commitment
term: 5 years; Vera Rubin capacity from early 2027
title_en: Meta up to $27B AI infrastructure deal with Nebius
title_zh: Meta 与 Nebius 最高 270 亿美元的 AI 基础设施协议
summary_en: Nebius signed a five-year deal with Meta worth up to about $27B: $12B of dedicated Vera Rubin capacity from early 2027 and a commitment of up to $15B for capacity Nebius cannot sell to other customers.
summary_zh: Nebius 与 Meta 签署为期五年、最高约 270 亿美元的协议：自 2027 年初起提供 120 亿美元专属 Vera Rubin 算力，另有最多 150 亿美元用于兜底 Nebius 未能售予其他客户的容量。

subkind: offshore GPU compute rental (Nvidia B200, Malaysia)
amount_text: Undisclosed rental value; ~500 Blackwell systems (~36,000 B200 chips) whose hardware would cost >$2.5B, per WSJ
title_en: ByteDance rents Nvidia Blackwell cluster from Aolani Cloud in Malaysia
title_zh: 字节跳动向 Aolani Cloud 租用马来西亚英伟达 Blackwell 算力
summary_en: ByteDance is working with Aolani Cloud to use about 36,000 Nvidia B200 chips in Malaysia, according to the Wall Street Journal, and has made initial payments; Aolani has leased H100 servers to ByteDance there since February 2025. Aolani says its customers do not own the chips; renting capacity outside China is allowed under current US export rules.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，字节跳动与 Aolani Cloud 合作，在马来西亚使用约 3.6 万颗英伟达 B200 芯片，并已支付首期款项；自 2025 年 2 月起 Aolani 已在当地向字节出租 H100 服务器。Aolani 称客户并不拥有芯片；按现行美国出口规则，租用中国境外的算力是被允许的。

amount_text: NT$645.1B of 2025 revenue from 'client B', widely reported to be Apple (17% of TSMC revenue, down from 22%); ~US$20.6B at the exchange rate used for client A
title_en: Apple paid TSMC about $20.6B in 2025
title_zh: 苹果 2025 年向台积电支付约 206 亿美元
summary_en: TSMC's second-largest customer in 2025, reported to be Apple, contributed NT$645.1B, up 3.3% but slipping to 17% of revenue as Nvidia's AI orders overtook it. TSMC does not name customers.
summary_zh: 台积电 2025 年第二大客户（据报道为苹果）贡献 6451 亿新台币，增长 3.3%，但占比降至 17%，被英伟达的 AI 订单超越；台积电并未点名客户。

subkind: foundry wafer and packaging purchases (2025 total)
amount_text: NT$726.9B (~US$23.2B) of 2025 revenue from TSMC's 'client A', widely reported to be Nvidia (TSMC does not name customers); 19% of TSMC revenue (12% in 2024)
title_en: Nvidia becomes TSMC's largest customer ($23B in 2025)
title_zh: 英伟达成为台积电最大客户（2025 年约 232 亿美元）
summary_en: TSMC's 2025 figures show its largest customer, reported to be Nvidia, paid NT$726.9B (about $23.2B), more than double 2024, overtaking Apple. The identification comes from press reports and Jensen Huang's remarks, not from TSMC.
summary_zh: 台积电 2025 年数据显示，第一大客户（据报道为英伟达）贡献营收 7269 亿新台币（约 232 亿美元），较 2024 年翻倍以上，超越苹果；客户身份来自媒体报道和黄仁勋的表述，台积电并未点名。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'multi-billion', multi-year
term: Multi-year; possible direct TPU purchases from 2027
title_en: Meta rents Google TPUs in multi-billion deal
title_zh: Meta 签署数十亿美元谷歌 TPU 租用协议
summary_en: The Information reported that Meta signed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar deal to rent Google TPUs for training next-generation models; earlier reports said Meta could also buy TPUs for its own data centres from 2027.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 签署多年期、数十亿美元协议租用谷歌 TPU 训练下一代模型；此前报道称 Meta 可能自 2027 年起直接采购 TPU 部署于自有数据中心。

amount_text: +$100B over 8 years, incl. ~2 GW of Trainium capacity
title_en: OpenAI expands AWS commitment by $100B (Trainium)
title_zh: OpenAI 追加 1000 亿美元 AWS 承诺（Trainium 芯片）
summary_en: Alongside Amazon's $50B investment, OpenAI added $100B to its AWS agreement over eight years and committed to about 2 GW of Amazon Trainium capacity; AWS became the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier.
summary_zh: 在亚马逊投资 500 亿美元的同时，OpenAI 将 AWS 协议在八年内追加 1000 亿美元，并承诺使用约 2 吉瓦亚马逊 Trainium 算力；AWS 成为 OpenAI Frontier 平台独家第三方云分销商。

amount_text: Undisclosed value; more than 100 million advanced chips from TSMC Arizona in 2026
title_en: Apple to buy 100M+ chips from TSMC Arizona in 2026
title_zh: 苹果 2026 年将从台积电亚利桑那厂采购逾 1 亿颗芯片
summary_en: Apple said it is on track to buy more than 100 million advanced chips from TSMC's Arizona fab in 2026, up from 2025, under its $600B US investment pledge; procurement chief David Tom said Apple is taking as much of the fab's output as it can.
summary_zh: 苹果表示，作为其 6000 亿美元在美投资承诺的一部分，2026 年将从台积电亚利桑那厂采购逾 1 亿颗先进芯片，较 2025 年增加；其采购主管 David Tom 称苹果会尽可能买下该厂产能。

amount_text: Undisclosed by companies; reported ~$60B over 5 years to >$100B (WSJ); up to 6 GW
title_en: Meta deal for up to 6 GW of AMD GPUs
title_zh: Meta 采购最多 6 吉瓦 AMD GPU
summary_en: AMD and Meta agreed to deploy up to 6 GW of custom MI450-based GPUs in Helios racks, starting with 1 GW in the second half of 2026. Terms were not disclosed; reports range from about $60B to over $100B.
summary_zh: AMD 与 Meta 同意部署最多 6 吉瓦基于 MI450 的定制 GPU（Helios 机架），首批 1 吉瓦于 2026 年下半年开始。条款未披露，报道估值约 600 亿至逾 1000 亿美元不等。

amount_text: Undisclosed; millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs plus Grace/Vera CPUs
title_en: Meta multiyear deal for millions of Nvidia GPUs
title_zh: Meta 与英伟达签署数百万颗 GPU 的多年期协议
summary_en: Meta agreed a multiyear partnership to deploy millions of Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, the first large-scale Grace-only CPU deployment and Spectrum-X networking, on premises and via Nvidia cloud partners. Financial terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: Meta 与英伟达达成多年期合作，在自有及英伟达云合作伙伴数据中心部署数百万颗 Blackwell 和 Rubin GPU、首个大规模纯 Grace CPU 部署及 Spectrum-X 网络，财务条款未披露。

amount_text: ~€1.2B (~$1.4B) joint investment with EcoDataCenter
title_en: Mistral AI's $1.4B AI data centre in Sweden with EcoDataCenter
title_zh: Mistral AI 与 EcoDataCenter 在瑞典投资 14 亿美元建设 AI 数据中心
summary_en: Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter will invest about €1.2B in an AI data centre at EcoDataCenter's Borlänge site, which EcoDataCenter will design, build and run, designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs; opening is set for 2027.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 与 EcoDataCenter 将在 EcoDataCenter 位于博伦厄的站点投资约 12 亿欧元建设 AI 数据中心，由 EcoDataCenter 设计、建设和运营，面向英伟达 Vera Rubin GPU，计划 2027 年启用。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Micron's HBM4 sales passed $1B within about four months of first shipments (exact Feb 2026 shipment day not given)
title_en: Micron supplies HBM4 for Nvidia's Vera Rubin
title_zh: 美光为英伟达 Vera Rubin 供应 HBM4
summary_en: Micron began HBM4 shipments in February 2026 and announced high-volume production aimed at Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; Jensen Huang said all three memory makers are qualified and producing.
summary_zh: 美光于 2026 年 2 月开始出货 HBM4，并宣布面向英伟达 Vera Rubin 平台量产；黄仁勋表示三家存储厂商均已通过认证并在生产。

amount_text: ~$14B (about CNY 100B) planned 2026 Nvidia chip budget, per SCMP, not a signed contract total; ~10,000 H200 delivered by Aug 2026 per FT
title_en: ByteDance plans ~$14B of Nvidia H200 purchases in 2026
title_zh: 字节跳动计划 2026 年采购约 140 亿美元英伟达 H200
summary_en: ByteDance planned to spend about $14B on Nvidia chips in 2026 once H200 sales to China were allowed; Beijing reportedly approved H200 purchases for ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent in January 2026 under conditions. By August 2026 ByteDance had reportedly taken delivery of roughly 10,000 H200s, far below the licence ceiling.
summary_zh: 字节跳动计划在 H200 获准对华销售后于 2026 年斥资约 140 亿美元采购英伟达芯片；据报道，2026 年 1 月北京有条件批准字节、阿里和腾讯采购 H200。据报道，截至 2026 年 8 月字节约收到 1 万颗 H200，远低于许可上限。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Beijing approval Jan 2026; ~10,000 H200 delivered by Aug 2026 per FT
title_en: Tencent buys Nvidia H200 chips after approvals
title_zh: 腾讯获批后采购英伟达 H200
summary_en: Tencent was among the first Chinese firms Beijing reportedly allowed to buy Nvidia H200s in January 2026. By August 2026 it had reportedly taken delivery of about 10,000 units.
summary_zh: 据报道，腾讯是 2026 年 1 月首批获北京批准采购英伟达 H200 的中国企业之一。据报道，截至 2026 年 8 月已收到约 1 万颗。

amount_text: Undisclosed; supply-chain estimates put Samsung at ~25-30% of Nvidia's HBM4 volume
title_en: Samsung starts HBM4 shipments to Nvidia
title_zh: 三星开始向英伟达供应 HBM4
summary_en: Samsung was reported to begin official HBM4 shipments to Nvidia (and AMD) in February 2026 after passing qualification, with pricing near what Nvidia agreed with SK hynix.
summary_zh: 据报道，三星通过认证后于 2026 年 2 月开始向英伟达（及 AMD）正式供应 HBM4，价格接近英伟达与 SK 海力士商定的水平。

amount_text: $1.8B cash for the P5 site (land, buildings, cleanroom; no tools)
title_en: Micron buys PSMC's Tongluo fab for $1.8B to add DRAM/HBM capacity
title_zh: 美光以 18 亿美元收购力积电铜锣晶圆厂，扩充 DRAM/HBM 产能
summary_en: Micron agreed to buy Powerchip's P5 fab site in Tongluo, Taiwan, with about 300,000 sq ft of 300mm cleanroom, for $1.8B in cash and closed the deal on 15 March 2026; it will retrofit the site for leading-edge DRAM including HBM.
summary_zh: 美光以 18 亿美元现金收购力积电位于台湾铜锣的 P5 厂区（约 30 万平方英尺 12 英寸洁净室），于 2026 年 3 月 15 日完成交割，将改造用于包括 HBM 在内的先进 DRAM。

amount_text: >$10B for 750 MW (Jan 2026), roughly doubled to >$20B over 3 years (The Information, Apr 2026; the >$20B total is a press figure, not stated in the Cerebras S-1)
title_en: OpenAI compute deal with Cerebras (>$20B)
title_zh: OpenAI 与 Cerebras 的算力合同（逾 200 亿美元）
summary_en: OpenAI agreed in January 2026 to buy up to 750 MW of Cerebras-hosted inference compute, reported at over $10B; The Information reported in April that the commitment roughly doubled to more than $20B. Cerebras' filings also show OpenAI funded a ~$1B working-capital loan to Cerebras.
summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2026 年 1 月同意采购最多 750 兆瓦由 Cerebras 托管的推理算力，据报道价值逾 100 亿美元；The Information 4 月报道该承诺约翻倍至逾 200 亿美元。Cerebras 文件还显示 OpenAI 向其提供了约 10 亿美元营运资金贷款。

amount_text: ~$1B per year (Bloomberg; undisclosed by companies); no contract total
title_en: Apple licenses Google Gemini for Siri and Apple Foundation Models
title_zh: 苹果授权使用谷歌 Gemini 打造 Siri 与苹果基础模型
summary_en: Apple and Google announced a multi-year deal under which the next Apple Foundation Models and a more personal Siri will be built on Gemini, running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute. Bloomberg reported Apple will pay about $1B a year.
summary_zh: 苹果与谷歌宣布多年期合作，下一代苹果基础模型及更个性化的 Siri 将基于 Gemini 打造，并运行于苹果私有云计算。据彭博报道，苹果每年将支付约 10 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed by the companies; reported at about $20B in cash (CNBC)
title_en: Nvidia licenses Groq's inference technology
title_zh: 英伟达获得 Groq 推理技术授权
summary_en: Groq and Nvidia signed a non-exclusive licence for Groq's inference technology, and Groq's founder and senior leaders joined Nvidia while Groq stays independent; the reported ~$20B would be Nvidia's largest deal.
summary_zh: Groq 与英伟达签署 Groq 推理技术的非独家授权协议，Groq 创始人及高管加入英伟达，Groq 继续独立运营；据报道约 200 亿美元，为英伟达最大一笔交易。

amount_text: $10B order (Broadcom FQ3 2025) + $11B order (FQ4 2025) for Ironwood TPU racks; not counted here because Anthropic's S-1 shows it takes Broadcom TPU hardware under five-year master equipment leases (from 2025; ~$161.2B of rent in total, counted on anthropic-broadcom-2026-10-equipment-leases)
title_en: Anthropic buys $21B of Google Ironwood TPU racks from Broadcom
title_zh: Anthropic 向博通采购 210 亿美元谷歌 Ironwood TPU 机架
summary_en: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan revealed that Anthropic was the customer behind a $10B order and a further $11B order for complete Google Ironwood TPU racks, and later said Anthropic is on track to be Broadcom's largest custom-chip customer in 2027. Anthropic's S-1 shows it receives this hardware under five-year equipment leases with Broadcom, so the money is counted on the lease edge.
summary_zh: 博通 CEO 陈福阳披露，Anthropic 是一笔 100 亿美元及另一笔 110 亿美元谷歌 Ironwood TPU 整机架订单的买家，并表示 Anthropic 有望在 2027 年成为博通最大的定制芯片客户。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，这些硬件通过与博通的五年期设备租赁取得，因此金额计入租赁关系。

amount_text: At least $44.9B of Azure spend from November 2026 to May 2033, non-cancelable except for an uncured Microsoft breach or undelivered capacity, per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026, amended agreement); announced as $30B of Azure compute plus additional capacity up to 1 GW in Nov 2025
title_en: Anthropic commits $44.9B to Microsoft Azure ($30B announced)
title_zh: Anthropic 承诺采购 449 亿美元微软 Azure 算力（公告时为 300 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic committed in November 2025 to buy $30B of Azure compute and to contract additional capacity up to 1 GW (Nvidia Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin), as Microsoft and Nvidia agreed to invest in it. Its October 2026 S-1 shows the agreement was amended to a minimum of $44.9B of Azure spending between November 2026 and May 2033, owed regardless of usage.
summary_zh: Anthropic 于 2025 年 11 月承诺采购 300 亿美元 Azure 算力，并另签最多 1 吉瓦的额外算力（英伟达 Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin 系统）；同时微软和英伟达同意向其投资。其 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示协议已修订为 2026 年 11 月至 2033 年 5 月间最低 449 亿美元的 Azure 支出，无论实际用量如何均须支付。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Anthropic's $50B US data-centre programme (Texas, New York first) — the share paid to Fluidstack is not disclosed, so no amount is counted
title_en: Anthropic's $50B US data-centre build with Fluidstack
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Fluidstack 合作的 500 亿美元美国数据中心建设
summary_en: Anthropic announced a $50B investment in its own US data centres, built with Fluidstack, starting in Texas and New York with sites coming online through 2026. The $50B is Anthropic's whole programme; Fluidstack's share is undisclosed and not counted.
summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布投资 500 亿美元自建美国数据中心，由 Fluidstack 承建，首批位于得州和纽约州，2026 年陆续投运。 500 亿美元为 Anthropic 整体计划规模，支付给 Fluidstack 的份额未披露，不计入金额。

amount_text: ~$3B over 5 years
title_en: Meta ~$3B AI infrastructure contract with Nebius
title_zh: Meta 与 Nebius 约 30 亿美元的 AI 基础设施合同
summary_en: Nebius disclosed a five-year agreement worth about $3B to supply AI infrastructure to Meta.
summary_zh: Nebius 披露与 Meta 签署为期五年、价值约 30 亿美元的 AI 基础设施供应协议。

amount_text: ~$9.7B over 5 years incl. 20% prepayment
term: 5 years; phased deployment through 2026 at Childress, Texas
title_en: Microsoft $9.7B AI cloud contract with IREN
title_zh: 微软与 IREN 的 97 亿美元 AI 云合同
summary_en: IREN will give Microsoft access to Nvidia GB300 GPUs for five years at its Childress, Texas campus for about $9.7B, with a 20% prepayment; IREN is buying the chips from Dell for about $5.8B.
summary_zh: IREN 将在其得州 Childress 园区向微软提供为期五年的英伟达 GB300 GPU 算力，合同约 97 亿美元，含 20% 预付款；IREN 以约 58 亿美元向戴尔采购相关芯片和设备。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'multibillion-dollar', tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs incl. GB300 NVL72
title_en: Microsoft multibillion-dollar GPU deal with Lambda
title_zh: 微软与 Lambda 的数十亿美元 GPU 协议
summary_en: Lambda signed a multi-year, multibillion-dollar agreement to deploy tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, including GB300 NVL72 systems, for Microsoft.
summary_zh: Lambda 与微软签署多年期、数十亿美元协议，为其部署数万颗英伟达 GPU，包括 GB300 NVL72 系统。

amount_text: $38B over 7 years
title_en: OpenAI $38B AWS cloud contract
title_zh: OpenAI 与 AWS 的 380 亿美元云合同
summary_en: OpenAI signed a multi-year $38B agreement for AWS EC2 UltraServers with hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, its first big cloud deal outside Microsoft. It was extended by $100B in February 2026.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 AWS 签订为期多年、价值 380 亿美元的协议，使用搭载数十万颗英伟达 GPU 的 EC2 UltraServers，这是其在微软之外的首个大型云合同；2026 年 2 月该协议再扩大 1000 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs
title_en: Samsung builds an AI Megafactory on 50,000+ Nvidia GPUs
title_zh: 三星以 5 万余颗英伟达 GPU 打造 AI 超级工厂
summary_en: Samsung said it will deploy more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs and the Omniverse platform in an AI Megafactory that runs its chip, mobile and robotics manufacturing; the two also work together on HBM4.
summary_zh: 三星宣布将部署 5 万余颗英伟达 GPU 及 Omniverse 平台，建设覆盖其芯片、手机和机器人制造的 AI 超级工厂；双方还在 HBM4 方面合作。

amount_text: Incremental $250B of Azure services
title_en: OpenAI commits an extra $250B to Microsoft Azure
title_zh: OpenAI 追加 2500 亿美元微软 Azure 采购承诺
summary_en: In the October 2025 recapitalisation OpenAI agreed to buy an additional $250B of Azure, and Microsoft gave up its right of first refusal on OpenAI compute. An April 2026 amendment ended Azure exclusivity: OpenAI can sell on any cloud, Azure stays primary, and OpenAI's ~20% revenue share to Microsoft is capped and runs through 2030.
summary_zh: 在 2025 年 10 月的资本重组中，OpenAI 同意追加采购 2500 亿美元 Azure 服务，微软放弃对 OpenAI 算力的优先购买权。2026 年 4 月的修订终止了 Azure 独家：OpenAI 可在任意云上销售，Azure 仍为首选；OpenAI 向微软支付的约 20% 收入分成设上限并持续至 2030 年。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'tens of billions of dollars'; up to 1M TPUs, well over 1 GW in 2026
title_en: Anthropic expands Google Cloud TPU use to up to 1M chips
title_zh: Anthropic 将谷歌云 TPU 用量扩大至最多 100 万颗
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to use up to one million Google Cloud TPUs, an expansion worth tens of billions of dollars that brings well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026.
summary_zh: Anthropic 同意使用最多 100 万颗谷歌云 TPU，扩容价值数百亿美元，将于 2026 年上线超过 1 吉瓦算力。

amount_text: Undisclosed; ~200,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs; FT estimated up to ~$14B (other reports ~$24B)
term: Texas from Q3 2026, Portugal Q1 2026, UK Q1 2027, Norway via Aker JV
title_en: Microsoft contracts ~200,000 GB300 GPUs from Nscale
title_zh: 微软向 Nscale 采购约 20 万颗 GB300 GPU 算力
summary_en: Nscale contracted to deliver about 200,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs to Microsoft across Texas, Portugal, the UK and Norway. The value was not disclosed; the FT estimated up to about $14B. In October 2026 Microsoft pulled out of the UK site at Loughton, Essex (grid power not expected until the 2030s); Microsoft said the rest of the partnership stands.
summary_zh: Nscale 签约在得州、葡萄牙、英国和挪威向微软交付约 20 万颗英伟达 GB300 GPU 算力。金额未披露，英国《金融时报》估计最高约 140 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs from Q3 2026, expanding in 2027+
title_en: Oracle deploys 50,000 AMD MI450 GPUs
title_zh: 甲骨文部署 5 万颗 AMD MI450 GPU
summary_en: Oracle Cloud will be a launch partner for the first public AI supercluster on AMD Instinct MI450, starting with 50,000 GPUs in Q3 2026 and expanding from 2027.
summary_zh: 甲骨文云将成为首个基于 AMD Instinct MI450 的公共 AI 超级集群的首发伙伴，2026 年第三季度先部署 5 万颗 GPU，2027 年起扩容。

amount_text: Up to $5B to deploy Bloom fuel cells at Brookfield AI factories (first phase); first deal of Brookfield's AI Infrastructure strategy
title_en: Brookfield's $5B Bloom Energy fuel-cell deal for AI data centres
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德与 Bloom Energy 签订 50 亿美元 AI 数据中心燃料电池协议
summary_en: Brookfield agreed to invest up to $5B deploying Bloom Energy's fuel cells as behind-the-meter power for its AI data centres, making Bloom its preferred on-site power supplier.
summary_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德同意投资最高 50 亿美元，在其 AI 数据中心部署 Bloom Energy 燃料电池作为表后电源，Bloom 成为其首选现场电力供应商。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators and Broadcom Ethernet racks
term: Racks from H2 2026, complete by end-2029
title_en: OpenAI and Broadcom 10 GW custom accelerator deal
title_zh: OpenAI 与博通的 10 吉瓦定制加速器协议
summary_en: OpenAI will design its own AI accelerators and Broadcom will develop and deploy 10 GW of racks with them plus Broadcom networking, from the second half of 2026 to the end of 2029. Financial terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: OpenAI 自主设计 AI 加速器，由博通开发并部署搭载该芯片及博通网络设备的 10 吉瓦机架，时间为 2026 年下半年至 2029 年底，财务条款未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; AMD expects 'tens of billions of dollars' of revenue; 6 GW over several GPU generations
term: Multi-year; first 1 GW of MI450 from H2 2026
title_en: OpenAI 6 GW AMD Instinct GPU agreement
title_zh: OpenAI 与 AMD 的 6 吉瓦 Instinct GPU 协议
summary_en: OpenAI agreed to deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs across multiple generations, starting with 1 GW of MI450 in the second half of 2026. AMD said the deal should bring tens of billions of dollars in revenue.
summary_zh: OpenAI 同意跨多代产品部署 6 吉瓦 AMD Instinct GPU，首批 1 吉瓦 MI450 于 2026 年下半年开始部署。AMD 表示该协议预计带来数百亿美元收入。

amount_text: Undisclosed by the parties; the Wall Street Journal reported on 5 Oct 2025 that xAI would spend at least $18B on ~300,000 more Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2, excluding servers; neither xAI nor Nvidia has confirmed a total, so the figure is not counted
title_en: xAI to buy ~300,000 more Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2 (reported, at least $18B)
title_zh: xAI 据报将为 Colossus 2 再采购约 30 万颗英伟达 GPU（据报不少于 180 亿美元）
summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that xAI needed to spend at least $18B to buy the remaining ~300,000 Nvidia GPUs for its Colossus 2 data centre in Memphis, with Musk saying the site would reach 550,000 chips. No party has confirmed the figure, so it is listed as reported with no amount.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，xAI 需至少支出 180 亿美元为孟菲斯 Colossus 2 数据中心采购其余约 30 万颗英伟达 GPU，马斯克称该站点将达到 55 万颗芯片。各方均未确认该数字，因此标为据报且金额为空。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Stargate demand of up to 900,000 DRAM wafers/month
title_en: OpenAI memory-supply letter of intent with Samsung
title_zh: OpenAI 与三星的存储芯片供应意向书
summary_en: OpenAI signed a letter of intent in Seoul for Samsung to supply memory for Stargate, which OpenAI and its Korean partners said could need up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month. No value was disclosed.
summary_zh: OpenAI 在首尔与三星签署意向书，由三星为星际之门供应存储芯片；双方称星际之门需求可能高达每月 90 万片 DRAM 晶圆，金额未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Stargate demand of up to 900,000 DRAM wafers/month
title_en: OpenAI memory-supply letter of intent with SK hynix
title_zh: OpenAI 与 SK 海力士的存储芯片供应意向书
summary_en: OpenAI signed a parallel letter of intent with SK hynix for high-bandwidth memory for Stargate; SK said the stated demand is more than double current global HBM capacity.
summary_zh: OpenAI 同时与 SK 海力士签署意向书，为星际之门供应高带宽存储（HBM）；SK 称该需求是当前全球 HBM 产能的两倍以上。

amount_text: Up to $14.2B through 2031, option to expand to 2032
title_en: Meta $14.2B cloud contract with CoreWeave
title_zh: Meta 与 CoreWeave 的 142 亿美元云合同
summary_en: CoreWeave disclosed in a filing that Meta will buy up to $14.2B of Nvidia GB300-based compute through 2031, diversifying CoreWeave beyond Microsoft.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 在监管文件中披露，Meta 将在 2031 年前采购最多 142 亿美元基于英伟达 GB300 的算力，帮助 CoreWeave 降低对微软的依赖。

amount_text: ~$20B reported (Bloomberg/Reuters, Sep 2025 talks); neither company has confirmed a contract or amount. Oracle cited new Meta commitments in Dec 2025 RPO without figures
title_en: Meta ~$20B cloud contract with Oracle
title_zh: Meta 与甲骨文约 200 亿美元的云合同
summary_en: Bloomberg and Reuters reported in September 2025 that Oracle was negotiating a roughly $20B multi-year AI cloud deal with Meta. In December 2025 Oracle said its $68B quarterly backlog increase was driven by new commitments from Meta, Nvidia and others, without giving amounts.
summary_zh: 彭博和路透社 2025 年 9 月报道，甲骨文正与 Meta 洽谈约 200 亿美元的多年期 AI 云合同。2025 年 12 月甲骨文表示当季剩余履约义务（RPO）增加 680 亿美元，主要来自 Meta、英伟达等的新承诺，但未披露金额。

amount_text: ~$300B over ~5 years (WSJ; Oracle and OpenAI have not confirmed the figure); ~4.5 GW of Stargate capacity
title_en: OpenAI cloud compute contract with Oracle (Stargate 4.5 GW)
title_zh: OpenAI 与甲骨文的云算力合同（星际之门 4.5 吉瓦）
summary_en: OpenAI announced a 4.5 GW Stargate data-centre partnership with Oracle in July 2025; the WSJ reported the contract at about $300B over roughly five years from 2027. It anchors Oracle's backlog (RPO $664B at 31 Aug 2026); Bloomberg reported some sites slipping to 2028, which Oracle denied.
summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 7 月宣布与甲骨文合作开发 4.5 吉瓦星际之门数据中心容量；据《华尔街日报》报道，合同金额约 3000 亿美元，自 2027 年起为期约五年。该合同是甲骨文剩余履约义务（RPO，截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日为 6640 亿美元）的主要来源；彭博曾报道部分站点推迟至 2028 年，甲骨文予以否认。

amount_text: $6.3B initial order value; Nvidia buys capacity CoreWeave cannot sell, through Apr 2032
title_en: Nvidia $6.3B backstop for CoreWeave's unsold capacity
title_zh: 英伟达为 CoreWeave 未售出算力提供 63 亿美元兜底采购
summary_en: CoreWeave disclosed a $6.3B order under which Nvidia must buy any of CoreWeave's cloud capacity not used by other customers through April 2032. Nvidia is also CoreWeave's GPU supplier and a major shareholder. It supports CoreWeave's borrowing but is not a guarantee of its debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 披露一份 63 亿美元订单：2032 年 4 月前，英伟达须购买 CoreWeave 其他客户未使用的云算力。英伟达同时是 CoreWeave 的 GPU 供应商和主要股东。这增强了 CoreWeave 的举债能力，但并非对其债务的担保。

amount_text: $17.4B through 2031, up to ~$19.4B with options; ~$7B of upfront payments tied to milestones
title_en: Microsoft $17.4B GPU capacity contract with Nebius
title_zh: 微软与 Nebius 的 174 亿美元 GPU 算力合同
summary_en: Nebius will supply Microsoft dedicated GPU capacity from its Vineland, New Jersey data centre through 2031 for $17.4B, or up to $19.4B with extra capacity, financed partly with debt secured on the contract.
summary_zh: Nebius 将在 2031 年前从其新泽西州 Vineland 数据中心向微软提供专属 GPU 算力，金额 174 亿美元，若追加容量最高 194 亿美元，部分资金以该合同为抵押的债务筹集。

subkind: AI inference chip procurement (via H3C and ZTE servers)
amount_text: Over CNY 1B (~$139M), across China Mobile's 2025-26 inference equipment tender
title_en: Baidu's Kunlunxin wins >CNY 1B China Mobile AI chip orders
title_zh: 百度昆仑芯中标中国移动逾 10 亿元人民币 AI 芯片订单
summary_en: Kunlunxin, 59%-owned by Baidu, said it won orders worth over CNY 1B for China Mobile AI projects, with chips going into servers from first-tier suppliers H3C and ZTE. A Huawei-related company won other parts of the tender.
summary_zh: 百度持股 59% 的昆仑芯宣布获得中国移动 AI 项目逾 10 亿元人民币订单，芯片将用于一级供应商新华三和中兴的服务器；招标其余部分由华为相关公司中标。

amount_text: >$10B over 6 years
title_en: Meta $10B+ Google Cloud deal
title_zh: Meta 与谷歌云逾 100 亿美元的合同
summary_en: The Information and Reuters reported that Meta signed a six-year Google Cloud deal worth more than $10B, mostly for AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 和路透社报道，Meta 与谷歌云签署为期六年、价值逾 100 亿美元的合同，主要用于 AI 基础设施。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Apple's American Manufacturing Program
title_en: Apple to have Samsung make new chips in Austin, Texas
title_zh: 苹果委托三星在得州奥斯汀生产新型芯片
summary_en: Apple named Samsung's Austin fab as a partner in its American Manufacturing Program to launch a new chipmaking technology; Apple did not say what the chips are, and industry experts expect stacked image sensors for future iPhones.
summary_zh: 苹果在“美国制造计划”中宣布与三星奥斯汀工厂合作推出全新芯片制造技术；苹果未说明具体产品，业内预计为用于未来 iPhone 的堆叠式图像传感器。

subkind: foundry manufacturing contract (AI6 chips, Taylor fab)
amount_text: ~$16.5B (KRW 22.76 trillion) from 24 Jul 2025 to 31 Dec 2033; Musk called it a minimum
title_en: Tesla $16.5B AI6 chip foundry contract with Samsung
title_zh: 特斯拉与三星的 165 亿美元 AI6 芯片代工合同
summary_en: Samsung disclosed a $16.5B chip manufacturing contract with an unnamed client running to 2033, and Elon Musk confirmed it is Tesla, whose AI6 chip will be made at Samsung's Taylor, Texas fab.
summary_zh: 三星披露一份为期至 2033 年、金额 165 亿美元的芯片代工合同，客户未具名；马斯克确认客户为特斯拉，其 AI6 芯片将在三星得州泰勒工厂生产。

amount_text: Undisclosed; finalised in May 2025 per Reuters sources
title_en: OpenAI adds Google Cloud as a compute supplier
title_zh: OpenAI 将谷歌云纳入算力供应商
summary_en: Reuters reported, citing three sources, that OpenAI signed up for Google Cloud capacity, a deal finalised in May 2025. Neither company disclosed its size or scope.
summary_zh: 据路透社援引三位知情人士报道，OpenAI 签约使用谷歌云算力，协议于 2025 年 5 月敲定，双方均未披露规模或范围。

amount_text: ~$40B for ~400,000 GB200 chips (FT)
term: Compute leased to OpenAI for 15 years
title_en: Oracle buys ~$40B of Nvidia chips for OpenAI's Abilene site
title_zh: 甲骨文为 OpenAI 阿比林站点采购约 400 亿美元英伟达芯片
summary_en: The FT reported that Oracle will spend about $40B on roughly 400,000 Nvidia GB200 chips for the first Stargate site in Abilene, Texas, and lease the computing power to OpenAI.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，甲骨文将斥资约 400 亿美元采购约 40 万颗英伟达 GB200 芯片，用于得州阿比林的首个星际之门站点，并将算力租给 OpenAI。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: AMD makes 2nm EPYC Venice and US-built CPUs at TSMC
title_zh: AMD 在台积电生产 2 纳米 EPYC Venice 及美国制造 CPU
summary_en: AMD said its next EPYC 'Venice' CPU is the industry's first HPC product taped out on TSMC's 2nm (N2) process, and that it validated 5th Gen EPYC CPUs at TSMC's Arizona fab, its first products made in the US.
summary_zh: AMD 宣布其下一代 EPYC “Venice” 处理器是业界首款在台积电 2 纳米（N2）工艺流片的高性能计算产品，并已在台积电亚利桑那厂完成第五代 EPYC 验证，这是 AMD 首批美国制造产品。

amount_text: ~$1.9B final payment (net of adjustments) at second closing on 27 Mar 2025; total deal ~$9B agreed 2020
title_en: SK hynix completes purchase of Intel's NAND business
title_zh: SK 海力士完成收购英特尔 NAND 业务
summary_en: SK hynix made a final payment of about $1.9B to Intel to complete its roughly $9B purchase of Intel's NAND and SSD business, folding the remaining IP and R&D staff into Solidigm.
summary_zh: SK 海力士向英特尔支付约 19 亿美元尾款，完成约 90 亿美元的英特尔 NAND 与固态硬盘业务收购，剩余知识产权与研发人员并入 Solidigm。

title_en: OpenAI cloud contracts with CoreWeave (~$22.4B)
title_zh: OpenAI 与 CoreWeave 的云算力合同（约 224 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave signed three contracts with OpenAI in 2025 worth up to about $22.4B in total, used to train OpenAI's next-generation models. The deals reduced CoreWeave's dependence on Microsoft, which was 62% of its 2024 revenue.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年与 OpenAI 签订三份合同，总价值最高约 224 亿美元，用于训练 OpenAI 下一代模型，降低了其对微软（占 2024 年收入 62%）的依赖。

amount_text: US$250M (~RM1.1B) over 10 years
title_en: Malaysia pays Arm $250M for chip design licences
title_zh: 马来西亚向 Arm 支付 2.5 亿美元购买芯片设计授权
summary_en: Malaysia agreed to pay Arm $250M over ten years for chip design licences and technology so local firms can design their own AI and data-centre chips.
summary_zh: 马来西亚同意在十年内向 Arm 支付 2.5 亿美元，获取芯片设计授权与技术，帮助本土企业自主设计 AI 与数据中心芯片。

subkind: GPU purchases (Nvidia systems bought through OEM partners)
amount_text: Undisclosed; no Nvidia purchase total is disclosed: CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPU servers through OEM partners such as Dell and Super Micro and its 10-K says it has no long-term supply contracts (three suppliers were 23%, 20% and 17% of 2025 purchases); cash paid for property and equipment was $10.3B in 2025 and $8.7B in 2024
title_en: CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPUs for its cloud (via OEMs, total undisclosed)
title_zh: CoreWeave 为其云平台采购英伟达 GPU（经 OEM 交付，总额未披露）
summary_en: CoreWeave's fleet runs on Nvidia GPUs: its S-1 says customers contractually specify Nvidia GPUs, and the GPUs arrive as servers from OEM partners such as Dell and Super Micro rather than under a disclosed Nvidia purchase contract. This is the buyer leg of the Nvidia-CoreWeave loop (Nvidia is also a CoreWeave shareholder and buys its unsold capacity); the amount is undisclosed, so it is not counted.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 的算力全部基于英伟达 GPU：其 S-1 注册文件称客户在合同中指定使用英伟达 GPU，GPU 以服务器形式经戴尔、超微等 OEM 合作伙伴交付，并无公开披露的英伟达采购合同。这是英伟达与 CoreWeave 循环交易中的采购一环（英伟达同时是 CoreWeave 股东并包销其未售出算力）；金额未披露，不计入总额。

amount_text: $3B per year to deploy OpenAI products across SoftBank group companies; no contract total
title_en: SoftBank to spend $3B a year on OpenAI products (Cristal intelligence)
title_zh: 软银每年斥资 30 亿美元采购 OpenAI 产品（Cristal intelligence）
summary_en: SoftBank agreed to spend $3B a year deploying OpenAI's solutions across its group companies and to form SB OpenAI Japan to sell them in Japan.
summary_zh: 软银同意每年投入 30 亿美元在集团各公司部署 OpenAI 的解决方案，并成立 SB OpenAI Japan 在日本销售相关产品。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 100,000 Nvidia Hopper (H100) GPUs in service at Colossus per Nvidia's 28 Oct 2024 release, then being doubled to 200,000; neither company has disclosed a purchase total
title_en: xAI buys 100,000+ Nvidia H100 GPUs for Colossus (total undisclosed)
title_zh: xAI 为 Colossus 超级计算机采购逾 10 万颗英伟达 H100 GPU（总额未披露）
summary_en: Nvidia's October 2024 release says xAI's Colossus cluster in Memphis runs 100,000 Nvidia Hopper GPUs on Spectrum-X Ethernet and was being doubled to 200,000. It is the buyer leg of the Nvidia-xAI loop (Nvidia later invested in xAI's Series E). No purchase price was disclosed, so the edge is not counted.
summary_zh: 英伟达 2024 年 10 月的新闻稿称，xAI 位于孟菲斯的 Colossus 集群运行 10 万颗英伟达 Hopper GPU，采用 Spectrum-X 以太网，并正扩充至 20 万颗。这是英伟达与 xAI 循环交易中的采购一环（英伟达后来参投 xAI 的 E 轮融资）。采购价格未披露，不计入总额。

subkind: custom chip foundry and co-investment framework (Intel 18A, Intel 3)
amount_text: Multi-year, multi-billion-dollar framework; exact value undisclosed
title_en: AWS multi-billion custom-chip deal with Intel (18A AI fabric chip)
title_zh: AWS 与英特尔数十亿美元定制芯片合作（18A AI 互连芯片）
summary_en: AWS and Intel announced a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar co-investment framework: Intel will make an AI fabric chip for AWS on Intel 18A and a custom Xeon 6 on Intel 3.
summary_zh: AWS 与英特尔宣布多年期、数十亿美元的共同投资框架，英特尔将以 18A 工艺为 AWS 生产 AI 互连芯片，并以 Intel 3 工艺生产定制版至强 6 处理器。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Intel said expected lifetime deal value across its foundry customers exceeds $15B
title_en: Microsoft chooses Intel 18A to make an in-house chip
title_zh: 微软选择英特尔 18A 工艺生产自研芯片
summary_en: At Intel Foundry Direct Connect, Intel said Microsoft plans to make a chip of its own design on Intel 18A; no contract value was given, and Intel put its foundry lifetime deal value above $15B.
summary_zh: 在英特尔代工大会上，英特尔宣布微软计划用 18A 工艺生产一款自研芯片；未披露合同金额，英特尔称其代工业务预计总合同价值超过 150 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; CNBC reported 'potentially billions of dollars over multiple years' in Jun 2023 (contract signed earlier in 2023); CoreWeave's 10-K puts Microsoft at ~67% of 2025 revenue of $5.1B and ~62% of 2024; day of announcement unknown (-01)
title_en: Microsoft, CoreWeave's largest customer, buys GPU cloud capacity
title_zh: 微软向 CoreWeave 采购 GPU 云算力（CoreWeave 最大客户）
summary_en: Microsoft agreed in 2023 to buy GPU cloud capacity from CoreWeave, reportedly to serve OpenAI's demand; the contract totals are undisclosed, but CoreWeave's annual report names Microsoft as its largest customer at about 67% of 2025 revenue (62% in 2024), a share management expects to fall as the OpenAI and Meta contracts ramp.
summary_zh: 微软 2023 年与 CoreWeave 签约采购 GPU 云算力，据报主要用于满足 OpenAI 的需求；合同总额未披露，但 CoreWeave 年报显示微软是其最大客户，约占 2025 年收入的 67%（2024 年为 62%），管理层预计随着 OpenAI 和 Meta 合同放量该比例将下降。
